description: Kenya - Logistics is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA). Ware House locations WFP and NCPB (national creals and produce board) Warehouses sourced from WFP, dated 2011 & 2012 respectively. Coverage: Kenya. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA). Its tags are geodata, logistics. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2024-09-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
